summary: Partially updates a line item on an inter-project transfer, or voids it when `void` is true.
description:
Updates one or more fields on an existing line item. Only the fields provided in the request body are modified.
Requires the caller to be a Company Admin, except when voiding: a Materials Management Admin can void.
- Sending "void": true voids the line instead of updating fields: its quantity is set to 0 and the void cascades to the matching line on the linked inter-project transfer shipment (IPS) in the destination project, atomically.
- The transfer must be in Final state, and only notes may be sent alongside void. Voiding requires the materials_management_void-enabled feature to be enabled.
- If a linked draft/final receipt blocks the void, a 400 Bad Request is returned with shipment_id and receipt_id details so the UI can surface the blocker.
